records.name: Journal of System Safety
records.scope_notes: System safety theory and methods, quantitative risk assessment, resilience, software safety, AI safety, and STPA. OSRI-fit examples include computational hazard analysis, existing-data studies, and literature synthesis. This record covers original and review articles; columns, letters, and editorials are not peer reviewed.

route.conditions: The official author guidelines exclude APCs, submission fees, and all other author payments. No membership, affiliation, selective waiver, or conference attendance is needed for the stated journal route. Account registration and a free ORCID are required. Peer review applies to original and review articles.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None: policy expressly rules out every form of author payment. Authors must clear rights to reused material.

fee_evidence.note: Journal-specific costs section expressly excludes submission fees, APCs, and any other author payments; original/review article types are distinguished from unreviewed content.

difficulty.basis: No ranking established in this expansion; peer review does not establish acceptance odds.

records.name: Serbian Journal of Management
records.publisher: University of Belgrade, Technical Faculty in Bor
records.scope_notes: Management science theory and practice. Engineering management methods, existing-data organizational research, decision methods, and systematic reviews are plausible fits when their management contribution is clear; this is broader management coverage rather than a specialist systems architecture journal.

route.conditions: Official instructions state that publishing is free and explicitly exclude processing and submission charges. English manuscripts; original research should be under 15 pages including figures/tables, and reviews up to 20 pages. Free publication is not described as a waiver or affiliation benefit.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated under the explicit free-publication policy; observe standard article length limits.

fee_evidence.note: Instructions explicitly exclude article processing and submission charges and state that manuscript publication is free; give research/review length limits and double-blind review.

difficulty.basis: No ranking established in this expansion; peer review does not establish acceptance odds.

records.name: Journal of Engineering Management and Competitiveness
records.publisher: University of Novi Sad, Technical Faculty Mihajlo Pupin, Zrenjanin
records.scope_notes: Engineering management, maintenance/risk/quality management, simulation, operations research, statistical models, and management information systems. Computational methods, existing-data studies, and synthesis can fit the engineering management contribution. Original, review, and short scientific papers are considered.

route.conditions: Journal policy explicitly makes submission, processing, and publication free, with no hidden costs. Single-blind review by at least two reviewers. AI use in research requires detailed disclosure; manuscript AI use is limited and generated intellectual content is prohibited. The policy and instructions disagree about copyright ownership; authors must resolve this before accepting publication terms.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None: journal policy explicitly excludes hidden costs and third-party publication payments.

fee_evidence.note: Article-processing-charge section expressly makes manuscript submission, processing, and article publication free and rules out hidden costs.

difficulty.basis: No ranking established in this expansion; peer review does not establish acceptance odds.

records.name: International Journal of Industrial Engineering and Management
records.publisher: University of Novi Sad, Faculty of Technical Sciences
records.scope_notes: Industrial engineering and production management, including engineering/project management, maintenance, quality, logistics, service engineering, and industrial AI. The scope explicitly includes theoretical/application research, surveys, and critical reviews; computational analyses and synthesis need a substantive industrial or production-management contribution.

route.conditions: Official instructions explicitly exclude submission and publication charges and separately say review is free. English papers of 4500–6000 words and at most 15 pages, including illustrations/appendices. No membership, affiliation, waiver, or conference attendance requirement is stated for this journal route.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None for the standard compliant article. Authors bear any permission fees for third-party material they choose to reuse.

fee_evidence.note: Journal-specific author information excludes APCs and submission charges, says authors are not charged for publication, and makes review free. Third-party permission fees are separately assigned to authors.

difficulty.basis: No ranking established in this expansion; peer review does not establish acceptance odds.

notes: Four additional journals; names and IDs were compared against research/discovery/systems-engineering.json and none duplicates its nine candidates. All four zero-fee claims come from directly inspected, official journal-specific pages covering submission and standard publication. No waiver or institutional agreement is assumed.

OSRI-fit descriptions are research judgments, not acceptance assurances. Suggested work is computational, methodological, based on existing data, or synthesis; new physical laboratory experiments and clinical practice are outside this scope.

JEMC has a substantive AI-use restriction relevant to Agentic-Powered-Research: research AI use must be scientifically justified and documented, while manuscript generation is restricted. Its current policy says authors retain copyright but its author instructions still require copyright transfer; no legal interpretation of this conflict is supplied.

IJIEM requires authors to obtain permissions and pay any associated fees for reused third-party material. Original or appropriately licensed material avoids this optional content-dependent expense; the journal itself expressly excludes submission, review, and publication charges.

Additional lead omitted: International Journal of Production Management and Engineering (Universitat Politecnica de Valencia). Official indexed text at https://polipapers.upv.es/index.php/IJPME/open_access and https://www.polipapers.upv.es/index.php/IJPME/about/submissions explicitly excludes submission/APCs, but full-page retrieval returned timeout/502 and the local HTTPS request failed certificate verification. Its indexed author/open-science policies also restrict preprints. It was not promoted to a verified record in this expansion.
